title: Fixed Training Script
definition: A script that trains an adapter for a language model, with specific considerations and fixes applied.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A recipe that trains an AI model by feeding it data, adjusting settings like learning rate, and saving the result. In this case, it's a script that creates a new version of an AI model called persona-fixed-adapter.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A code snippet designed to fine-tune a large language model, specifically the Mistral v0.3 model, on a dataset called DND_persona_training.jsonl. It applies a tokenizer fix to prevent repetition issues, and saves the result as the persona-fixed-adapter.
difficulty_levels.expert: A script that leverages the PeFT (Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning) approach to adapt the Mistral v0.3 model for specific tasks, in this case, improving the persona of the model. It uses a Lora configuration to transform certain model modules, and employs gradient checkpointing to reduce memory usage during training.

extra_fields.insight: The novelty of this concept lies in its application of the PeFT method to fine-tune a large language model, addressing a specific issue (repetition in the generated text) and improving the quality of the model's persona.
